gary_2026_10_30_how_to_get_your_startups.title: How To Get Your Startups Finances In Order
gary_2026_10_30_how_to_get_your_startups.label: Startup / Business
gary_2026_10_30_how_to_get_your_startups.place: Resident Company Club (Flatiron), To Be Announced
gary_2026_10_30_how_to_get_your_startups.summary: Gary's Guide: Whether you've raised funding, started generating revenue, or are building your business, do you have a system to track where the money goes? When a co-founder pays for something personally, how is that expense recorded, approved & reimbursed? Can you see what has been paid, what is still outstanding, & where the supporting documents are? Getting your finances organised starts with the processes you use every day. In this Lunch & Learn, we'll explore how to build simple financial systems that help you manage your startup's money & understand your business as it grows. What we'll cover Your DocumentationWhat invoices, receipts, contracts & payment records should you capture-and how can you keep them organised? Your Financial ProcessesHow can you set up a consistent system for invoicing, payments, expense claims & founder reimbursements, so nothing gets missed or paid twice? Your BookkeepingHow do your everyday records become reliable accounts, & what should you keep updated each month? Your NumbersWhat can revenue, margins, profit, cash flow & runway tell you-and which numbers should you regularly review? Your Business DecisionsHow can your numbers help you plan spending, assess pricing & decide whether you can afford your next hire? Your Readiness for OpportunitiesHow can organised records & clear financial reports help you prepare information for tax filing, grant applications & funding conversations? This session is perfect for startup founders, entrepreneurs & early-stage teams-including those who have already raised funding-who want to establish practical financial systems & better understand their business performance. Presented by Mathura Kannan, ICAEW Chartered Accountant, Managing Director of Simply Empowering & Co-Founder of Expop, who works with businesses to set up financial processes, manage their accounting & turn their numbers into useful insights.

gary_2026_11_01_jersey_city_claude_code_.title: Jersey City - Claude Code Workshop
gary_2026_11_01_jersey_city_claude_code_.label: Tech / AI
gary_2026_11_01_jersey_city_claude_code_.summary: Gary's Guide: Claude Code Community Weekend One mini challenge. One hour. Let's see what we can build! Join a vibe-coding night in Jersey City, organized by local Claude community leaders. No coding background needed-developers, designers, PMs, & curious first-timers are all welcome! The challenge We'll form teams of 2-4 onsite, then reveal a mini challenge. Every team tackles the same problem with Claude Code, with one hour to bring their solution to life. Build a prototype or aim for a fully working product-then demo it live! The first 8 teams with verified demos get to present. Same challenge, different ideas. Come experiment, meet fellow builders, & cheer each other on. Registration & teams Each attendee must register & be approved individually. Your approval doesn't guarantee a spot for your friends or teammates, so come ready to meet new people & form a team onsite! Come ready to build Bring your laptop, charger, & access to Claude Code - ideally set up before you arrive. No pre-built project needed; we'll reveal the challenge together! Location Near Grove Street, Jersey City. The exact location will be shared once your registration is approved. A possible plot twist If a new Claude model launches within the two weeks leading up to the event, we may switch to a Build Day format to explore it together. We'll notify approved attendees if the format changes!

gary_2026_11_04_startup_pitch_mixer.title: Startup Pitch Mixer
gary_2026_11_04_startup_pitch_mixer.label: Startup / Business
gary_2026_11_04_startup_pitch_mixer.summary: Gary's Guide: Join our event in New York! We design Pitch & Networking nights to help founders sharpen their thinking through direct, candid feedback & to give strong investors access to serious teams. Our pitch night is complemented by a structured networking session before & after the pitch session. What to expect: Startups pitch live & receive focused feedback from angels & VC partners Structured networking session before & after the pitches Entrepreneurs, startup founders, & operators are joining to network, exchange ideas, & build strong connections Active investors & venture scouts joining to discover the best startups early Who you will meet at the event: Founders Investors, VC partners, Venture Scouts Marketers, Salespeople, Business Advisors Industry Disruptors AI Experts Entrepreneurs from Europe, Asia, & the United Kingdom We Welcome New Investors: We invite investors to our event to expand their network, get acquainted with new startups, evaluate them, share feedback, & participate in discussions with early-stage & serial founders. We offer complimentary tickets to institutional investors, angels, & venture scouts with a proven track record. If you'd like to access our database of promising startups or provide mentorship support to our best startups, please fill out this short Investor Application Form, & our team will contact you. Want to Pitch? A limited number of founders will have the opportunity to pitch their startup or business to a panel of investors & experts. 4-6 selected founders will pitch their startup, followed by a short Q&A where participants can ask questions & share feedback. Apply by filling out the Pitch Application Form & sending us your pitch deck. Spots are limited, & we select founders in advance. To maintain high-quality pitches, you are required to present with a pitch deck. We will share our pitching guide and, if you'd like, coach you so you're fully prepared for pitch night. The best startups will be featured across our social media & included in our investor newsletter. Requirements for attendees: Dress code: smart casual. Bring good energy. Join our event & secure your ticket today! About us: Startup Valley is a global event organizer hosting pitch nights in 25 cities since 2023. Since then, we have hosted 850 events for 40,000 attendees. Over these years, we connected countless outstanding early-stage startups to serious investors, & we are not planning to stop. We maintain strategic partnerships with VC funds in the US, Europe, & Asia to support our community. Do you have a question, a partnership proposal, or want to clarify something? Reach us at hello@startupvalley.club Agenda 18:00-18:30 - Registration: Guests register, receive badges, & event programs. This is an opportunity for casual networking, making first connections, & preparing for the event. 18:30-19:00 - Event Kickoff & Interactive Networking: Official welcome from the organizers with a brief overview of the event goals & schedule. Interactive networking session to connect with key contacts. 19:00-19:50 - Startup Pitch Session: Startups present their projects to investors & experts. Each team has 5 minutes to pitch, covering the project's core idea, business model, & target market. 19:50-21:00 - Chill & Networking: Participants enjoy casual conversations with investors, discuss collaboration opportunities, & exchange ideas over refreshments. FAQ Can I pitch? Yes! To pitch, please purchase a Pitch Ticket & fill out the Pitch Application Form. We will contact you to discuss & approve your pitch. The pitch duration is 5 minutes. You will also have some time to answer questions from the audience. How does the pitch go? Selected founders present on stage to the audience & the investors in the room. You get 5 minutes to pitch your idea, business model, target market, & investment ask, followed by a short Q&A. The best startups are featured across our social media channels & in the investor newsletter. Who will I meet? Founders, angel investors, VC partners, venture scouts, AI experts, engineers, operators, marketing & sales experts, & international entrepreneurs from across Europe, Asia, & the US. Do investors get free tickets? Yes! Please apply above or email hello@startupvalley.club, & we will issue a complimentary ticket for you & your team. Can I request a refund? Yes. Refunds are available if requested at least 1 day before the event start time. Please submit the refund request on the platform where you purchased your ticket, or email us at hello@startupvalley.club

gary_2026_11_04_growth_council_off_the_r.title: Growth Council - Off-The-Record Problem Solving For Scaling Founders
gary_2026_11_04_growth_council_off_the_r.label: Startup / Business
gary_2026_11_04_growth_council_off_the_r.summary: Gary's Guide: Are you a founder or entrepreneur? If so, you know that scaling your business past Seed & Series A can expose many gaps in your business all at once - talent/employee friction, messy positioning, legal nuances, capital efficiency...and the list goes on. And while most founder events only focus on panels with generic advice, our new event "The Growth Council" aims to do something different. The mission of this event is to give the founder community access to experts who can help you at your specific stage of growth. The Growth Council is a small-group, peer-to-peer advisory session built specifically for Seed to Series B founders who want to explore their challenges with experts from across the industry & outside their network. Founders will have access to experts in various areas, rotating at specific intervals to ensure they meet with as many experts as possible (think speed dating, but less awkward). These conversations are meant to challenge assumptions & empower founders with new perspectives on their most pressing problems. You'll walk away with fresh perspectives, a bigger network, & connections who can help facilitate you on your journey towards success. The Expert Council Bring us your founder questions, your bottlenecks, or gut-check a current decision & get actionable takeaways from those who have been there before. You'll meet with cross-functional leaders such as: TJ Allison (Sales Advisor & Executive Coach, TJAllison.com) - Sales expert who focuses on revenue & the "Inner Game" to grow revenue & sense of self. Simon Gibson (Fractional VP of Marketing, Formerly GIPHY) - Marketing leader who blends creative storytelling & data-driven strategy to build culturally relevant brands & scale businesses. Rebekah Huber (Cofounder, Kindred Works) - Ops specialist who builds the systems that give founders their time back. Anna Kaplan (Founder & CEO, Narrativ By AK) - Narrative & messaging specialist who helps founders craft a story that wins the room. Marc Kaufman (Partner, Potomac Law Group) - Intellectual property attorney specializing in creating IP assets that increase funding. Fractional CFO TBD Agenda 6:00 PM - 6:30 PM | Arrivals & Light Bites Casual networking over food & drinks before we kick off. 6:30 PM - 6:45 PM | Council & Sponsor Intros Quick, 60-second introductions from each expert on the specific fires they help extinguish. 6:45 PM - 7:45 PM | Growth Council Huddles Rotate at regular intervals. At each table, state your burning question, get sharp direct feedback from the functional expert, & compare notes with peer founders. 7:45 PM - 8:30 PM | Drinks & Direct Connections Informal wrap-up to continue conversations with experts & founders. Who Should Apply This event is strictly curated for Seed, Series A, & Series B founders / co-founders leading venture-backed tech startups. Capacity is strictly capped at 35 founders to maintain small group sizes & high-signal discussions. Requests to join will be reviewed to preserve the peer dynamic. Hosted By: Kindred Works - Fractional operations & employee engagement partners for high-growth startups. Narrativ by AK - Strategic positioning & narrative development for founders. gary_2026_11_05_startup_mixer.summary: Gary's Guide: NYC Tech &Startup Mixer - brought to you by Startup+ We're putting founders, engineers, investors, recruiters, freelancers, & mentors in the same room for a night of straightup networking. No panels, no speeches-just real conversations. If you're testing an idea, raising cash, or hiring your first dev, this is the place to be. Newsletter (exclusive entry & event drops): https://newsletter.startupplus.club Sponsorship / press: email - contact@startupplus.club Volunteer (Complimentary Ticket): email - contact@startupplus.club Why swing by? Meet 100+ builders & backers in one go Swap stories, get quick feedback, share lessons learned Spot future cofounders, investors, customers-maybe all three What's the setup? We've got a dedicated space, & name tags at the door Flash a business card or a LinkedIn QR-whatever works Dress code? Businesscasual. Jeans totally fine. A quick word on Startup+ We kicked this off in 2021, in the middle of the pandemic, because Zoom mixers just weren't cutting it. Fastforward: 25k members, 75+ mixers, 12 pitch nights, & 6000 folks through the doors. We keep it simple-connect good people & let the magic happen. Headsup: capacity is capped. Only confirmed Luma RSVPs are admitted at the door. Walkins = no go. Fine print : By joining, you agree that photos/video taken may be used in future Startup+ promos. Also, you agree that the contact info collected will be used to send future event invites & promotions via newsletter/other event platforms. See you IRL!!!

jc_culture_10003575_2026_11_04_hamilton_.summary: Join us at the Hamilton Park Farmers Market, your midweek destination for fresh, local, and thoughtfully crafted food and goods. Each week, we’re proud to feature farm-fresh produce from Stony Hill Farm alongside a curated selection of specialty vendors. Browse a variety of offerings including our long time vendor Pickles and Olives, fresh seafood from Scale Fish Market, and prepared foods perfect for dinner. You can also find baked goods, candles, personal care products, and more. You can even take advantage of convenient services like on-site knife sharpening while you shop. On the first and second Wednesdays of each month, enjoy live entertainment that adds to the vibrant, community atmosphere of the market. Whether you’re shopping for the week, grabbing a bite, or simply enjoying the park, the Hamilton Park Farmers Market is a welcoming space to connect with local vendors and neighbors.
